newsitem.title: HUNGARY: TVK TO PAY 8 PCT DIVIDEND FROM JUNE 16.
newsitem.headline: TVK TO PAY 8 PCT DIVIDEND FROM JUNE 16.

text.p: Hungarian chemicals company Tiszai Vegyi Kombinat Rt (TVK) said on Tuesday it will pay an eight percent or 80 forints per share dividend on its 1996 results.
"Dividend payment will start on June 16," the company said in a statement following its annual shareholders meeting.
TVK paid a 7.4 percent dividend on its 1995 results.
In 1996 TVK posted an IAS unconsolidated net income of 7.69 billion forints, down from 10.47 billion in 1995.
The statement said TVK will use its 5.33 billion forints retained earnings for development plans.
